resources.string: Achievements are finally here, synced with Steam: the ones earned here show up on Steam, and the ones earned elsewhere show up here.
Offline mode is supported: games can be played without a connection, and their saves are sent as soon as the network is back.
Sign-in with an account name and a password, besides the QR code.
Saves are sent while a game is played, not only when it ends, and the saves page shows at a glance what is synchronized with Steam and what is not.
The Steam region to download from can be chosen, interrupted downloads resume by themselves, and a badge shows how many games are being installed.
Games with expansion files start: the files follow the installed version and are readable by the game.
Other games are supported too without having been tried, among them Unreal games that were blocked by their expansion files.
Not patched now because they are on screen: %1$s.
Some games are patched without any confirmation and others ask for one: it is a constraint of the game, not of GamePort.
Some games were not patched and can be patched from their page: %1$s.
